subject: chemistry
content: n-Butane is produced by the monobromination of ethane followed by the Wurtz reaction. Calculate the volume of ethane at NTP required to produce 55 g n-Butane, if the bromination takes place with 90 percent yield and the Wurtz reaction with 85 percent yield.
